text:
Hello!! Question about conflicting Visa applications.
I am married to an Israeli citizen and plan to submit the required documents to PIBA. However, I am currently on a Student Visa in Israel, which must be renewed soon — my university handles this as usual. 

Question: If I submit the documents and they schedule me for an appointment in X months, can I renew my student visa afterward, before the first meeting? 

I have read on the AIC page that you cannot have two visa applications at the same time, but between the submission and the first interview, one is not granted a visa. Does submitting already count as starting a process? (I am asking this because I heard of a case in which someone's student visa was not renewed because the person had submitted the documents to PIBA.)

Thank you for your help!
